verdict.rationale: Spending caps and budget alerts are a fair question for a pay-per-token inference cloud, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a spending limit, budget cap or billing alert. Pay-as-you-go pricing claims ('no surprises', 'no minimums') and the capacity-related fail_fast HTTP 429 are adjacent features, not spend controls.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
